The ရုပ်ရှင် Database (TMDB)

KhaYin uses the TMDB API for movie and TV metadata, artwork, trailers, cast, production details, collections, and recommendations. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

KhaYin uses IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets, including title.ratings.tsv.gz, for IMDb ratings and vote counts. Information courtesy of IMDb (https://www.imdb.com). Used with permission. IMDb data is for personal and non-commercial use under IMDb's terms.
KhaYin connects to Trakt for account authentication, watched history, progress sync, library data, ratings, lists, and comments. KhaYin is not affiliated with or endorsed by Trakt.

KhaYin connects to Simkl for account authentication, watchlists, watched history, playback progress, and scrobbling. ရုပ်ရှင်, TV, and anime tracking data is provided by Simkl. KhaYin is not affiliated with or endorsed by Simkl.
KhaYin connects to Premiumize for account authentication, cloud library access, cache checks, and cloud playback features. KhaYin is not affiliated with or endorsed by Premiumize.
KhaYin connects to TorBox for account authentication, cloud library access, cache checks, and cloud playback features. KhaYin is not affiliated with or endorsed by TorBox.
KhaYin uses MDBList for ratings and external score provider data. KhaYin is not affiliated with or endorsed by MDBList.
KhaYin uses the IntroDB API for community-provided intro, recap, credits, and preview timestamps used by skip controls. KhaYin is not affiliated with or endorsed by IntroDB.
